comparison.objective: Insert three color-mapped patch cords fully into specified numbered ports, leaving other ports empty; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Read a mapping, align keyed plugs, and push them to latch in small ports versus align a mandrel in inserts, stabilize it during impacts, and recover fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Every cord fully inserted in its mapped port, all other ports empty, and plugs released versus four fractures and four deposited tangs without damage.
comparison.reason: This is the closest precision-insertion record, but it tests keyed plug alignment and latching, not calibrated fracture impacts or loose-fragment containment. Numeric seating and force tolerances are absent.
